_doc: Test units (awto-ddc). Bus numbers change on reboot; NVIDIA connectors have no i2c link: dev.py finds the bus whose EDID (0x50) carries the unit serial and refuses to flash a bus that doesn't. relay = mains outlet (scripts/power_cycle.py). test=false: Dan's working screens; dev.py refuses them unless --force. bus_kind / bus_kind_dp: ddc (HDMI/DVI DDC wires) or dp-aux (I2C over DP AUX) of connector / connector_dp; dev.py flash passes it to rtd_flash_image (NVIDIA adapters cannot tell DP from HDMI by name). write_mode: dev.py flash default (byte|burst); byte on a dp-aux bus is always switched to burst (#177).

1.note: 2026-11-27: Dan: tests on unit 3 only; finished images go on units 1/2 (with --force) only when Dan asks. 2026-11-19: Dan: units 1, 2 and 3 all free for flashing and tests, no restrictions. 2026-11-08T14:00: Dan's working screen again, hands off (tests on unit 2 only, memory units-test-policy).2026-11-06 10:41: NVIDIA HDMI-A-3 (I2C bus via EDID scan, e.g. 18). 2026-11-07: test unit too (Dan), still his working screen: no relay, keep layout; cable in monitor input D3 (isp_port.py)

2.note: 2026-11-28: Dan recabled: unit 2 now only on NVIDIA card2-DP-2 (I2C-over-AUX, slow: no drm_dp_aux on NVIDIA, #380), left screen at 0,2160. 2026-11-27: Dan: tests on unit 3 only; finished images go on units 1/2 (with --force) only when Dan asks. 2026-11-19: Dan: units 1, 2 and 3 all free for flashing and tests, no restrictions. 2026-11-13T11:30: working screen now (hands off); test unit is unit 3.2026-11-13T10:55: HDMI cable moved to unit 3; unit 2 now only on Intel DP-1 (bus 15), D1 re-enabled from the selector by Dan. 2026-11-08T19:08: Sonoff so-th-1 feeds unit 2 (Dan); power-cycled it via scripts/power_cycle.py after the wb-p14audio1 flash failure (#96). 2026-11-08T14:11: D1 (DP) cabled by Dan from Intel DP-1 (bus 15), off the desktop unless mirrored into HDMI-2 (dev.py mode --unit 2 --dp mirror); D2 HDMI stays. 2026-11-08T11:42: recabled by Dan to Intel HDMI-A-2 (bus 11), was NVIDIA DP-4. 2026-11-07: test unit too (Dan, 'upgrade unit 2'); Dan's PRIMARY screen: layout/position never change; NVIDIA DP-4 (AUX i2c bus via EDID scan), 0x4A ACKs over AUX; Dan 2026-11-07: no vendor dump needed for unit 2 (dump-twice rule waived for this unit only; unit 1's vendor dump stays the model reference)

3.note: 2026-11-28: Dan recabled: unit 3 now only on Intel card1-DP-1 (drm_dp_aux0: aux-fast flash 175 sectors in 52 s), enabled by gdctl (temporary) at 3840,0 above the Philips; its old HDMI-A-2 and NVIDIA DP-4 cables are gone (Philips 288E2 now on Intel HDMI-A-2 bus 11 + NVIDIA DP-3). 2026-11-20: Dan wired a DP cable to unit 3 too: NVIDIA card2-DP-4 (EDID serial AWT26110003), switched OFF in GNOME on purpose (layout is as Dan wants it): never enable it; free for KVM / input-switch tests via the monitor side (D1). 2026-11-13T12:00: KEEP Rotate 180 (Dan: 'leave it there for that monitor'), stored in NVRAM; a --full flash erases NVRAM -> set disp_rotate 180 again after any flash and check it. 2026-11-13T11:30: TEST UNIT from now on (Dan: 'all tests on the monitor at the top'); units 1 and 2 are working screens. The Sonoff so-th-1 relay still feeds unit 2, not unit 3: hass_power cycles of the test unit need Dan to move the relay. 2026-11-13T10:53: RECOVERED over Intel HDMI-A-2 bus 11 (unit 2's cable moved by Dan), image wb-p14ui-rec3, health ACTIVE 4K60; now on card1-HDMI-A-2. 2026-11-13T08:31: OFFLINE, half-flashed (wb-p14ui-one1 byte mode over DP AUX stopped at 5/214 sectors, scaler reset; DP-4 dark, no AUX/ISP answer). Replaced on DP-4/DP-2 by the Philips (Dan). Recovery: ISP over an HDMI DDC bus (unit 2's Intel HDMI-A-2 cable into unit 3's HDMI input), resume in burst mode.
